text:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm starting a canary for redwood-inference-runtime chart 2.3.0 into staging with GPU override (gpuType: nvidia-a100-40gb) and a nodeSelector change.

maria: Values I'm applying:```yaml
image:
  tag: v2.3.0
resources:
  requests:
    nvidia.com/gpu: 1
nodeSelector:
  runtime: gpu
gpuType: nvidia-a100-40gb
secrets:
  tlsSecret: redwood-staging-tls
```

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary=redwood-inference-runtime/staging v2.3.0 (pods 2/5) — rollout id 0a9c

ashok: quick question — did we pin the chartDependencies? last time a transitive lib changed k8s API and caused preflight failure.

maria: yes pinned in Chart.lock, but I overrode the secret name to match staging. verified the KMS path.

kevin: seeing deploy-bot log: `CrashLoopBackOff` on inference-worker-0 with error `failed to load TLS cert: secret "redwood-staging-tls" not found`

maria: uh — I thought the secret was in the staging namespace. checking...

maria: confirm: secret missing in staging cluster. I had created it in the test cluster by mistake. my bad.

olivia: :eyes: that's a showstopper for canary. if TLS is missing, we risk retries and cascading failures. Suggest pause and create secret first.

deploy-bot: canary paused by human: @maria (reason: pod crash on start, missing secret)

maria: creating secret now from vault: `kubectl create secret generic redwood-staging-tls --from-file=tls.crt=./staging.crt --from-file=tls.key=./staging.key -n staging`

srebot: vault-to-k8s sync complete for secret redwood-staging-tls in staging (audit_id: a12f)

maria: scaling canary back to 2 pods to verify: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/redwood-inference-runtime -n staging --field-selector=metadata.name=inference-worker`

kevin: pods are coming up, logs show TLS handshake success now. :thumbsup:

ashok: quick prod-question: was any DB migration bundled into this release? we should avoid rolling migrations in first canary.

maria: good catch — there is an optional migration job flagged in values: `runMigrations: false` for staging. I kept it off.

olivia: once staging is stable for 30m we should do a pinned-chart canary to prod with image tag pin and no automatic migration. Ops runbook updated.

maria: agreed. I'll let the canary run for 45m then open a prod rollout PR that pins `image.tag: v2.3.0` and explicitly sets `runMigrations: false` and `imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent`.

deploy-bot: canary healthy: 5/5 pods ready (90s), latency SLOs within 95th pct target.

kevin: note for release notes — call out TLS secret manual step and chart dep pin. saves someone else a morning.

maria: logging that in the PR description and changelog. thanks everyone. :shipit:

olivia: also adding a preflight check to our release pipeline to ensure required secrets exist in the target namespace before canary starts (issue #RIF-248).

ashok: :100: good follow-up.

maria: closing the thread — I'll post the prod rollout PR when ready.
